 November 11, 2026 12:59 pm Plus Religion & Faith No, We Don’t Need to Make Diwali a Federal Holiday
 by Jim Geraghty 
 Share this story
 Share on Facebook Share on X Share on LinkedIn More sharing options Hindu devotees light candles for the Hindu god Chiva during the Karthigai Deepam festival in Bangalore, India.
 Manjunath Kiran/AFP via Getty Images
 Text size Gift comments I don’t begrudge anyone the desire to have the major holidays of their particular religious faith named a federal holiday. Representative Grace Meng , a Democrat who represents Queens in New York City, wants to make Diwali a federal holiday and recently said in an interview that she thinks Democratic control of the House and Senate could improve the chances of making that happen.
